description.en: Specialized search engine spanning the growing ecosystem of shadcn registries.
description.zh: 横跨全网各大开源 shadcn 社区注册表的高效垂直组件搜索引擎。

content.en: Shoogle is a unified search index and component discovery engine spanning hundreds of independent shadcn/ui community registries. It indexes components, dependencies, authors, and CLI install commands, allowing developers to search the decentralized registry ecosystem from one clean interface.
content.zh: Shoogle 是面向去中心化 shadcn/ui 社区注册表生态的垂直搜索引擎。它统一索引了全球各大创作者发布的独立 Registry、组件依赖项、作者元信息以及一键 CLI 安装命令，帮助前端开发者快速定位并横向对比散落在各处的优质组件。
